# Test fixtures

`SRR10958838_20k_R{1,2}.fastq.gz`: the first 20,000 read pairs of SRA run
SRR10958838 (BioProject PRJNA602697), *M. abscessus* subsp. *massiliense* 1239
grown in SCFM2. KAPA RNA HyperPrep (dUTP, reverse-stranded), NextSeq 2x76.
Public data from Wiersma et al. 2020, ACS Infect Dis 6:2143-2154,
doi:10.1021/acsinfecdis.0c00214. Downloaded from ENA.

Used by `tests/integration/test_correctness_gate.py` and
`tests/integration/test_run_end_to_end.py`.
